notes:
Account snapshot: large legal discovery vendor focused on regulated enterprise customers (banks + insurance legal teams). Expect 3–5 year platform relationship if POC meets compliance bar.

Key ask: private/VPC deployment with customer-managed keys, immutable audit logs, and 7+ years retention for certain regulatory docs. Heavy emphasis on provable deletion paths and exportable audit trails.

POC scope (short):
- Index ~5M doc objects (mixed PDF, DOCX, scanned OCR) -> embeddings store + candidate retrieval
- Reranking step on top of ANN results for final doc scoring and redaction hints
- Query volume expected: bursty (up to 1k qps for search), baseline 200 qps.
- Latency targets: reranker p95 < 300ms; end-to-end search p95 < 600ms in EU/NA regions.
- Cost goal: <$0.005 per query (embeddings+rerank amortized) for steady-state; acceptable to be higher during POC.

Security notes: "We cannot accept shared keys in hosted environment" — Head of Security. SSO via SAML mandatory; need SOC2 report + evidence of encryption-in-transit and at-rest using customer KMS.

Quote from last call (01/27): "If you can show a predictable cost curve for 5M docs and provide audit logs we can start procurement."

CRM shorthand: POC + security questionnaire in flight. Legal team reviewing data residency and retention clause. SE to demo private deployment topology next week.

poc_requirements:
- Dataset: 5M docs (mix of OCR, PDF, MS Office).
- Embedding index size: estimate 5M x 768-d vectors (storage + vector DB sizing needed).
- Reranker: transformer-based lightweight ranker hosting; must be pinned in private cluster.
- Metrics: recall@10, MRR, latency p50/p95, cost per query.
- Observability: per-query token-level cost breakdown and audit trail per request.
technical_constraints:
- No shared-hosted keys; use customer KMS/HSM.
- VPC peering only during maintenance window.
- On-prem ingest connector to avoid long data egress.
- Redaction/PII flags required in reranker output for compliance review.
commercial_notes: Looking for 3-year committed Dedicated/Private contract. Pricing sensitivity around index storage and reranker compute. Wants upfront examples of unit economics (per-query + per-embedding storage). Procurement expects legal clauses for data retention and auditability.
risk_summary: High compliance risk if retention/audit not demonstrable. Medium technical risk around network peering timeline and HSM attestations. Low adoption risk — strong product fit once compliance boxes checked.
final_comments: AE recommends follow-up SSO test, provide SOC2 + ISO artifacts, and a short cost model for 5M doc index with 200 qps baseline. SE to prepare private deployment topology + rough sizing by 2026-02-22.
